description.default: A card-based homepage: recent documents, quick notes, a month calendar, a full-text search box, workspace statistics and a pinnable quick-access shelf. Cards can be dragged to reorder and resized in fixed steps. Pinned documents can be grouped and reordered by dragging a group's grip; the shelf fits more columns the wider it is on desktop and tablet, adapts to single or multiple columns on phones, and truncates over-long titles.
description.zh_CN: 卡片式主页：最近打开文档、灵感随记、可翻月的日历、全文搜索框、使用统计与可 Pin 的快速访问。卡片可拖动排序与分档缩放；固定的文档可分组、可拖拽调整分组顺序，电脑与平板横向拉宽即多列铺开、手机按屏幕自适应单列或多列，过长标题自动截断，空的「未分类」自动隐藏。
